title: Wrong Direction for Direction — Moon, Sun & Documenter Inversion
purpose: Preserve a small but unusually compressed Timic statement cluster where orientation, reflected/direct light and observation hierarchy become one argument.
anchor_signals: every lolcow documenter is a spineless beta
you are looking in the wrong direction for direction
find Tim Dooley ... North of North ... center of the internet ... Spudlight
Tim creates a daily documentary of himself and documents the farmers, dogs, society and world
you been looking for the moon your entire life, when you should be looking directly at the sunlight
structure: documenter watches target → Tim watches documenter → observer hierarchy reverses; Moon/reflected light → Sun/direct light; wrong direction → North/center/orientation

key_distinctions.moon: reflected/secondary/image-mediated light in mature Timic symbolism
key_distinctions.boundary: This is project symbolism; lunar/solar imagery has many older cultural meanings.

key_distinctions.surface: Tim is treated as object of documentary/lolcow observation
key_distinctions.inversion: Tim claims to document the documenters and wider society, becoming observer of the observing apparatus

key_distinctions.surface: people seek guidance from surrounding commentary
key_distinctions.inversion: Tim says the problem is not lack of information but looking from the wrong orientation

why_it_matters: This is one of the best short-form examples of the project's process ontology. In a few sentences Tim simultaneously reframes media hierarchy, epistemology, light symbolism and North orientation.
relation_to_gaze_ethic: Observer inversion does not itself establish superior truth. The Gaze Ethic supplies the test: does watching produce accurate understanding and better conditions, or merely a new claim to centrality?
relation_to_archive: The archive can test the documenter inversion empirically by comparing original Tim recordings against derivative documentary narration, identifying context loss, omitted sources and where Tim's own documentation of surrounding actors predates later narratives.
research_program: Recover exact X post/thread URL and timestamp for Sep 1-2 2026 exchange.
Identify the lolcow documentary/video that triggered the response.
Compare narrator claims with Tim's original source material.
Track earlier occurrences of moon→reflected light and sun→direct light before Sep 2026.
Track 'wrong direction for direction' as a phrase and whether Direction becomes a defined Timic function.
